units.source_text: 明石夫人怨恨源氏昨夜态度冷淡。

en.t: Lady Akashi resented Genji for his cold manner toward her the previous night.

units.source_text: 然而回想他那悲伤过度的模样，竟像另换了一个人，觉得很可怜，便丢开了自身的事，为他流下同情之泪。

en.t: Yet when she thought back on how overcome with grief he had looked, almost as if he had become another person, she felt great pity for him; setting aside her own concerns, she shed tears of sympathy for him.
